title: Vue API Fetcher
description: Fetch and display data from a public API using Vue 3 lifecycle hooks

steps.title: Fetch on Mount
steps.description: Create a Vue app with a users data array. Use the mounted() lifecycle hook to fetch from https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users. Store the result and log the count.
hints: Use fetch(...).then(res => res.json()).then(data => { this.users = data; console.log('Fetched', data.length, 'users'); })

verification.failureMessage: Make sure you fetch from the API in mounted() and log the count

steps.title: Display Users
steps.description: Use v-for to render each user. Show name in an <h3> and email in a <p>.

verification.successMessage: Users render with names and emails!
verification.failureMessage: Display each user's name and email from the API

steps.title: Loading State
steps.description: Add a loading data field initialized to true. Show 'Loading...' while fetching, then the user list when complete.

verification.successMessage: Loading state works — users see feedback while fetching!
verification.failureMessage: Add a loading state that shows while data is being fetched

steps.title: Error Handling
steps.description: Add an error data field. In the .catch(), set error message and loading = false. Show the error in red if it occurs.
hints: Set this.error = err.message in the catch block

verification.successMessage: All three states handled: loading, success, and error!
verification.failureMessage: Add error state handling for when the fetch fails
